description: Schedule content with explicit target accounts, queue placement, recurrence, platform overrides, media library attachments, and score gating.

bypassToken.description: Optional bypass token returned from a previous score gate warning.

body.description: Compatibility alias for content text. If both are provided, text wins.

mediaUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS media URLs for carousels or multi-asset posts.

text.description: Primary post caption or body text.

threadTweets.description: Optional X thread tweets after the primary tweet.

mediaType.description: Optional media type hint for this tweet.

mediaUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS media URL for this tweet.

mediaUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS media URLs for this tweet.

text.description: Tweet text for this follow-up post.

title.description: Optional title for platforms that support titles such as YouTube or Pinterest.

mediaAttachments.description: Optional media library assets to link to the scheduled post.

saveToLibrary.description: If true, preserve this asset in the media library after scheduling.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL for the attachment.

platformOverrides.description: Optional per-platform overrides keyed by platform ID. Use this for platform-specific text, title, description, or publish settings.

count.description: Maximum number of occurrences to create.

until.description: Stop generating occurrences after this ISO 8601 time.

recurrenceEndDate.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time to stop the recurring series.

recurrenceRule.description: Optional RRULE string for advanced recurring schedules.

scheduleMode.description: Scheduling strategy. Use 'queue' to place the post into the next available queue slot.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 time for exact scheduling. Required unless scheduleMode is 'queue'.

scoreGate.description: Optional minimum content score threshold. If unmet, the tool can return a bypass token instead of scheduling.

targetAccounts.description: Connected account IDs to schedule to. These determine the target platforms.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for queue resolution and recurrence.

name: schedule_content_advanced
title: Schedule Content Advanced
